history.notes: Fixed About text - it referenced window.__fxVersionInfo, a global that was never actually set anywhere, so it always showed a hardcoded stale fallback regardless of real version. Now reads data/version.json directly and also shows live effect/category counts.
Fixed error log viewer to show context detail, not just the headline message.
5 new effects: Random B&W Hits, Motion Blur Whip, Crash Zoom Hard, Chroma Flash Hit, Laggy Energy Shake.
